title: PRE-RAID: WIDER KIT COLUMN SO PACK NAMES SHOW WHOLE, A CALM BUY BUTTON
why: The critic scored the page 3 and named the pack names cut to dots beside the new buy slot and a lime price that competes with ascend. The kit column may now grow to 480 px (it was 400) and the map gives up the width; the affordable price is plain light text on the raised fill, with red kept for what you cannot afford.
now: The pre-raid pack names show in full and the price buttons are calmer.
